title: Not silky
text: Not silky. This material is like a very cheap sport shirt material. It’s quite awkward to have as a pillow case. I know it says cooling but I think regular nice cotton would have the same cooling effect. There is an awkward metal zipper on these as well. If you want a pillow case with material that’s like a sport shirt this is probably your only bet.
